**What would you like Burrow to do?**
A clear description of the feature.

**Why**
The problem it solves, or what it would make easier.

**Does Mole already support it?**
Burrow drives the Mole CLI (`mo`) and never reimplements its cleaning logic. If this needs a new capability in Mole itself, it may belong in https://github.com/tw93/mole/issues. Which `mo` command or option would it use, if you know?

**Ideas for how it could look or work**
Sketches, screenshots or examples are welcome.
